pages.text: Every region of the Accretion Frontier has its hazard, and each has an answer.

$(li)$(thing)Nebula$() - blinding dust: the $(item)Adaptive Optics Visor$().$(li)$(thing)Asteroid Belt$() - micrometeorites: the $(item)Whipple Shield$() (a quarter per piece); low gravity: $(item)Gravity Compensators$().$(li)$(thing)Pulsar Field$() - its radiation pulse: $(item)Radiation Plating$() on your armour; high gravity: Gravity Compensators; Time Dilation: an $(item)Atomic Clock$() in the off hand.

$(li)$(thing)Accretion Rim$() - heat: the $(item)Thermal Shroud$() (or a full Refractory Suit); its tidal pull: the $(item)Tidal Brace$() (or a Precision Gyroscope in the off hand).$(li)$(thing)Lensing Void$() - frame dragging: a $(item)Precision Gyroscope$() in the off hand; warped sight: the Adaptive Optics Visor.

The four pieces of the $(item)Frontier Suit$() are made of Station Hull, each round a piece of the region it answers: an Einstein Ring Lens, an Accretion Disk Fragment, a Tidal Shear Crystal and a Planetary Core Sample (the reference mass the boots weigh gravity against).
